existing_features.title: Add smooth, consistent graphic transitions for route/page changes across the app so navigating between pages feels animated (e.g., fade/slide in), while respecting accessibility (disable/limit animations when the user has prefers-reduced-motion enabled).

Move the existing “Report an Issue” trigger on the Home page to the bottom of the Home page content (visually near the end of the page, above the global footer), keeping the same dialog behavior and English label text.
